## 科技新闻
1. **Cerebras explains how it serves trillion-parameter models at 1,000–2,000+ tokens/s**: using open-source Kimi K3 (~3T params, 69 linear-attention + 24 dense layers) as the example: at 4-bit weights each layer is ~16 GB, so a 44 GB WSE-3T wafer holds two linear layers or one dense layer plus its KV cache — 59 wafers total. Weights never move; only activations hop between wafers over RDMA (~2 µs per hop), and the pipeline stays full with many micro-batched requests in flight, so on-chip KV memory caps concurrency. Useful context now that OpenAI runs SOTA models on Cerebras; ~224 points on HN. https://www.cerebras.ai/blog/how-we-deploy-trillion-parameter-frontier-models-on-cerebras [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50227356)
> **[zh]** **Cerebras 讲解如何以每秒 1000–2000+ token 跑万亿参数模型**：以开源 Kimi K3（约 3T 参数，69 层线性注意力 + 24 层稠密层）为例：4-bit 权重下每层约 16 GB，一片 44 GB 的 WSE-3T 晶圆放两层线性层，或一层稠密层加它的 KV 缓存——共 59 片晶圆。权重不动，只有激活值通过 RDMA 在晶圆间传递（每跳约 2 微秒）；流水线里同时跑大量微批请求，因此片上 KV 内存决定并发上限。OpenAI 已把 SOTA 模型放上 Cerebras，这篇是很好的背景；HN 约 224 分。
2. **Dan Luu: "We should be more ambitious with the software we build"**: with agents, things that used to be absurd side quests now take hours — he built a regex engine and ripgrep fork tuned to his Codex workloads, and a Rust interpreter with ~50x faster cold builds, mostly because a 10–100x faster model makes ripgrep, Rust compiles and filesystem syscalls the bottleneck. GPT-6 Astra passes zstd's tests >99% of the time for about $1, so he moved his evals to IMAP and Pandoc; he argues most programmers still carry a "pre-agentic cost model", and includes Yossi Kreinin's rebuttal that most people should be less ambitious. ~514 points and 450+ comments on HN. https://danluu.com/ambitious/ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50225695)
> **[zh]** **Dan Luu：「我们做软件应该更有野心」**：有了 Agent，过去荒唐的支线项目现在几小时就能做完——他做了针对自己 Codex 负载调优的正则引擎和 ripgrep 分支，以及冷编译快约 50 倍的 Rust 解释器，起因是模型快 10–100 倍后，ripgrep、Rust 编译和文件系统调用会成为瓶颈。GPT-6 Astra 实现 zstd 通过测试的概率超 99%，成本约 1 美元，他只好把评测换成 IMAP 和 Pandoc；他认为多数程序员还带着「Agent 之前的成本模型」，文中也附上 Yossi Kreinin 的反驳：大多数人反而该少些野心。HN 约 514 分、450 多条评论。
3. **三星电视被曝用 AI 分析截屏和音频做精准广告**：IT之家援引 Tom's Hardware，安全研究员逆向 2025 款三星电视发现，Tizen 系统会大量处理音频、屏幕截图和广告标识符，并跑卷积神经网络分析用户看了什么、跳过哪些广告；没有麦克风时还会找条形音箱、蓝牙设备的麦克风录音。HN 上相关帖称它在 960×540 截图上跑 TensorFlow Lite 模型，约 110 分。https://www.ithome.com/1/017/670.htm [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50230181)
> **[en]** **Samsung TVs reportedly use AI on screenshots and audio for targeted ads**: IT Home, citing Tom's Hardware, says a security researcher reverse-engineered a 2025 Samsung TV and found Tizen heavily processing audio, screenshots and the ad ID, running a CNN to analyze what you watch and which ads you skip; without a built-in mic it looks for soundbar or Bluetooth device mics. The HN thread says it runs a TensorFlow Lite model on 960×540 frames; ~110 points.
4. **Electrum wallet: malicious servers swap just-sent transactions so a fee bump pays the attacker**: Electrum before 4.8.3 trusted its server for unconfirmed transactions without checking signatures; a malicious server hides the real broadcast and shows a fake one paying an attacker address ground to match the last four characters, and if the user then bumps the fee via RBF the wallet signs a valid payment to the attacker. Exploited in the wild with at least one confirmed loss; upgrade to 4.8.3 and check every output before signing, including fee bumps. https://pwn.watch/i/electrum-malicious-server-rbf-fee-bump-theft
> **[zh]** **Electrum 钱包：恶意服务器调包刚发出的交易，用户一加手续费就付给了攻击者**：4.8.3 之前的 Electrum 对未确认交易直接信任服务器、不验签名；恶意服务器吞掉真实广播，显示一笔假交易，收款地址被刻意碰撞成后四位一致，用户若再用 RBF 加速，钱包就会签出一笔真正付给攻击者的交易。已有在野利用、至少一人确认损失；请升级到 4.8.3，签名前（包括加速）核对每个输出地址和金额。
5. **The Verge: Google's AI search changes upended online publishing**: The Stepback recaps how AI Overviews and AI Mode broke the clicks-for-content deal — DMG Media told the UK CMA click-through fell up to 89%, Pew found people click less when an Overview appears, and lawsuits (Chegg, Penske) have mostly failed. Google now shows sources more prominently, runs a News AI licensing pilot with 400 publishers and is testing payments for content used in AI answers, while Reddit reportedly considers cutting Google off. https://www.theverge.com/column/1017983/google-ai-search-online-publishing
> **[zh]** **The Verge：Google 的 AI 搜索改变颠覆了网络出版业**：The Stepback 回顾 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 如何打破「内容换点击」的默契——DMG Media 向英国 CMA 称点击率最多降 89%，皮尤调查发现出现 AI 摘要时人们更少点链接，Chegg、Penske 等的诉讼大多失败。Google 现在把来源展示得更醒目，与 400 家媒体做 News AI 授权试点，并在测试为 AI 回答所用内容付费；另据报道 Reddit 也在考虑切断 Google。

2. **InfoQ：Linux 基金会报告称四分之一 PR 是「AI 垃圾」，写代码快了 52%、维护者更累了**：报告《Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era》显示，受访者估计用生成式 AI 后写代码耗时平均降 52%；维护者估计约 25% 的 PR 属低质量「AI slop」，大型项目达 31%，59%（大型项目 69%）称贡献量增加。71% 认为 AI 降低了参与门槛，但 53% 不认为社区信任提升；只有 35% 的项目有正式 AI 贡献政策，LF 建议明确测试、文档和 AI 使用披露要求。https://www.infoq.cn/article/9TSuUDxrUSGS26XTA2yB
> **[en]** **InfoQ: Linux Foundation report says a quarter of PRs are "AI slop" — coding is 52% faster, maintainers are more tired**: the report "Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era" finds respondents estimate generative AI cut coding time by 52% on average; maintainers estimate ~25% of PRs are low-quality "AI slop" (31% in large projects), and 59% (69% for large projects) see more contributions. 71% say AI lowers the barrier to entry but 53% disagree that it improved community trust; only 35% of projects have a formal AI-contribution policy, and the LF recommends clear rules on testing, documentation and AI-use disclosure.

> **[en]** **36Kr: CAICT report says average Chinese LLM prices have risen to ~13 yuan, nearly doubling after two years of price wars**: per 36Kr's morning brief citing Jiemian, CAICT's AI institute released its 2026 LLM token-service performance report on Oct 23: the normalized average price of domestic model services was 6.8 yuan in H2 2025 and 13.46 yuan so far this year, close to a 2x rise; typical foreign models released in 2026 average ~117.8 yuan, still far above domestic prices.
